name: Billy Jackson
source: Billy used to be a friend of Jeremy's when they were kids, before Jeremy changed cities. They met again after a lot of years and they seem to have a lot in common: both enjoy the party life-style and want to have a good time. Seems Billy is well-off and wants to use his money to build up some sort of modelling brand, and he's looking for girls to work with and invest in.
